description: What moving to a cheaper home actually frees up, after selling costs, the mortgage, stamp duty and buying costs. Use for 'how much would we free up selling at £600k and buying at £400k'.

additionalProperty.description: Already own another property, so the stamp duty surcharge applies. Defaults to false.

currentValue.description: What the current home would sell for.

mortgageRemaining.description: Mortgage left on it. Defaults to 0.

otherBuyingCosts.description: Legal, survey and moving costs on the purchase. Defaults to 3000.

sellingCostsPct.description: Agent and legal fees on the sale, as a %. Defaults to 1.5.

name: calculate_downsizing
title: Downsizing
